name: Waruiko, Chii-chan
source:
Shiho and Chizuru have been friends since they were children. Chizuru has had a stutter all his life. Later, he also got a social anxiety disorder, which rendered him unable to function on his own. Shiho's always had it all together, so she took on the role of his caretaker when they were still little. This dynamic continued as they grew up, but Shiho wasn't all that happy about it...

...so she took her anger out on Chizuru.

[Translated from [url=https://www.dlsite.com/girls/work/=/product_id/RJ325768.html]DLsite[/url]]
translation:
Shiho与Chizuru从小就是朋友。Chizuru自幼口吃，后来又患上社交焦虑障碍，无法独立应对生活。Shiho向来做事妥当，因此两人还小时，她便承担起照顾他的角色。长大后，这样的相处模式仍未改变，可Shiho对此并不十分满意……

……于是，她将怒火发泄在了Chizuru身上。

[译自[url=https://www.dlsite.com/girls/work/=/product_id/RJ325768.html]DLsite[/url]]
